faqs.q: How much can I save with solar energy?
faqs.a: Savings depend on energy consumption and system size. Most users see 70-90% reduction in electricity bills.

faqs.q: How long does a solar installation take?
faqs.a: Timelines vary by size. Residential systems typically take 3-5 days, while commercial projects take 2-4 weeks.

faqs.q: Is solar energy suitable for businesses?
faqs.a: Yes. It's one of the best investments for businesses to reduce fixed operational costs and claim accelerated depreciation.

faqs.q: Do solar panels require maintenance?
faqs.a: Minimal maintenance is needed. Regular cleaning and an annual electrical inspection ensure peak performance.

faqs.q: Can solar systems work during cloudy weather?
faqs.a: Yes. They generate electricity in daylight, though at a lower efficiency than on bright sunny days.
